rapport_notes: Joanna is professional, warm, and patient; she acknowledges the customer's concerns and uses reassuring language throughout.
process_discipline_notes: Joanna did not hold silence after asking 'Does that make sense?' mid-pitch; she immediately continued explaining the service.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: So we just need to ask you questions about it. Of course in order for us to provide more personalized estimates.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Are there any special concerns that you want us to discuss over the phone about this move about moving in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Joanna probed: apartment layout (stairs), square footage confirmation, extra rooms, garage furniture, balcony items, oversized/fragile items, packing needs, TV mounts, box count estimate, and parking access — multiple follow-ups per concern.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with_answered_anywhere: First is our no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming_answered_anywhere: Also meet your mover feature. Rest assured able we don't take daily contracted workers our guys are the most competitive most professional movers in the industry and we'll send you their names ahead of time to let you know who's coming to help out with the move.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_covered_anywhere: And lastly on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts by the end of the day.
evidence_quotes.communication_covered_anywhere: Not explicitly covered — no mention of day-before call, named crew lead, or inbox updates.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typically a two bedroom apartment usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours to complete. Now. In your case, since we're coming from the second floor and going to a two story home considering the travel distance in between as well. For the meantime, I'll just put your move one to five and a half to six and a half hour mark, which is an estimated budget of $1,532 including the travel fee already.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_commit_to_rate: Everything is already included and we also include other features our customer, our competitors usually don't offer. Again no hidden fees of any type. No credit card fees, no stair will fees. That's all in the price for, for the clock.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_beats_it_pay_less: If we go over the minimum we only charge in fifteen minute increments.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_self_prep_tip: How organized we are on the day, if you're planning to move some of the smaller items yourself as well, those factors can help make things quicker. And then the shorter to move the lower the cost you only pay for how long it takes after the twenty and a half hour minimum.
evidence_quotes.close_context: Customer declined the quote citing higher price than competitors; Joanna offered to send email and suggested flexible dates for savings, but no explicit rate-lock or close ask was made before customer said goodbye.

top_strength: Joanna executed exemplary discovery: she asked the agenda question before probing, then systematically went two layers deep on multiple logistics concerns (floor access, square footage, items, packing, parking), gathering comprehensive information to route the customer correctly to a virtual walkthrough.
coaching_note: Communication differentiator (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was never covered anywhere on the call; add this to Stage 2 takeaway for future walkthrough-scheduler calls, and hold silence after open-ended questions like 'Does that make sense?' to avoid stepping on the customer's response.
